chapterInfo.content:
20
Sofar kasa sɛ: Abɔnefoɔ yiedie nkyɛ
1 # Hiob 15.18 Ɛnna Naamani Sofar buaa sɛ:
2Me ho pere me nti,
m’adwene yɛ me sɛ memmua.
3Mate atenetene a asopa me,
nanso honhom firi me nhunumu mu bua me.
4Wonnim yei a ɛfiri tete,
ɛfirii sɛ wɔde nnipa sii asase soɔ no,
5sɛ abɔnefoɔ ahurisidie nkyɛ,
na nyaatwomfoɔ anigyeɛ yɛ berɛ tiaa bi?
6 # Dwom 37.35 Sɛ ne kɛseyɛ korɔn kɔpem ɔsoro,
na ne tiri kɔka mununkum a,
7 # 1 Ah 14.10 ɔbɛyera koraa sɛ ne sɛbeɛ;
wɔn a wɔhu no no bɛbisa sɛ: Ɔwɔ he?
8 # Dwom 73.20 Ɔbɛtu akɔ sɛ daeɛ, na wɔrenhu no,
na wɔbɛpamo no akɔ sɛ anadwo adehunu.
9 # Dwom 37.10 Aniwa a ahu no renhu no bio,
na ne tenabea renhu no bio.
10 # Hiob 27.14 Ne mma bɛpata mmɔborɔfoɔ,
na ne nsa adane n’ahodeɛ ama.
11Ne mmeranteberɛ mu ahoɔden hyɛɛ ne nnompe mama,
na afei ɛne no abɛda dɔteɛ mu.
12Sɛ adebɔne yɛɛ n’anomu fremfrem,
na ɔde siee ne tɛkyerɛma ase,
13na ɔdii adɔna na wannyaa mu,
na ɔmaa no kaa ne dodom a,
14afei deɛ n’aduane asakyera ne nsono mu,
nhuritia borɔ wɔ ne yam.
15Wamene adedodoɔ, na ɔbɛfe bio,
Onyankopɔn bɛtu afiri ne yam.
16Ɔbɛfefe ahuritia borɔ,
na ɔprammire tɛkyerɛma bɛku no.
17N’ani rennye nsuwansuwa ho,
ɛwoɔ ne nufosuo ani sradeɛ asuasu nsubɔntene ho.
18 # Deut 28.30-33 Ɔbɛdane deɛ wabrɛ ho ama,
na ɔremmene,
n’adeɛ a wanya no, ɔrenni ho ahurisie,
sɛdeɛ ne dodoɔ teɛ no.
19Ɛfiri sɛ wapɛkyɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ apo wɔn,
na wafa efie a ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔsiiɛ.
20Ɛnam sɛ ne yafunu ammee da nti,
ɔrenkora deɛ n’ani gye ho no biara.
21Wannidi annya bi da,
enti n’ahonyadeɛ rentena hɔ.
22N’adedodoɔ mayɛ mu ne ho bɛhiahia no,
amanehunufoɔ nyinaa nsa bɛba ne so.
23Ɔbɛma n’abufuhyeɛ aba ne so
ama no de ahyɛ n’afuru ma,
na ɔbɛma no atɔ agu ne so de ayɛ n’aduane.
24Ɔdwane firi dadeɛ akodeɛ ano a,
kɔbere mfrafraeɛ agyan bɛwɔ no ahwire ne mu;
25 # Dwom 7.12; Deut 32.41 ɔtu firi ne honam mu
na agyan no firi ne bɔnwoma mu a,
ewuo ho hu bɛto ne so.
26 # Deut 32.22 Wɔde sum nyinaa asie n’akoradeɛ,
ogya a obi mfite mu bɛhye no,
ɛbɛhye deɛ aka ne ntomadan mu.
27Ɔsoro bɛyi n’amumuyɛ adi,
na asase bɛsɔre atia no.
28Wɔbɛsoa ne fie ahonyadeɛ akɔ,
wɔbɛtwe akɔ, n’abufuo da no.
29Yei ne onipa ɔbɔnefoɔ kyɛfa a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,
ne n’agyapadeɛ a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ama no no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Ɛnna Naamani Sofar buaa sɛ:
Me ho pere me nti,
m’adwene yɛ me sɛ memmua.
Mate atenetene a asopa me,
nanso honhom firi me nhunumu mu bua me.
Wonnim yei a ɛfiri tete,
ɛfirii sɛ wɔde nnipa sii asase soɔ no,
sɛ abɔnefoɔ ahurisidie nkyɛ,
na nyaatwomfoɔ anigyeɛ yɛ berɛ tiaa bi?
Sɛ ne kɛseyɛ korɔn kɔpem ɔsoro,
na ne tiri kɔka mununkum a,
ɔbɛyera koraa sɛ ne sɛbeɛ;
wɔn a wɔhu no no bɛbisa sɛ: Ɔwɔ he?
Ɔbɛtu akɔ sɛ daeɛ, na wɔrenhu no,
na wɔbɛpamo no akɔ sɛ anadwo adehunu.
Aniwa a ahu no renhu no bio,
na ne tenabea renhu no bio.
Ne mma bɛpata mmɔborɔfoɔ,
na ne nsa adane n’ahodeɛ ama.
Ne mmeranteberɛ mu ahoɔden hyɛɛ ne nnompe mama,
na afei ɛne no abɛda dɔteɛ mu.
Sɛ adebɔne yɛɛ n’anomu fremfrem,
na ɔde siee ne tɛkyerɛma ase,
na ɔdii adɔna na wannyaa mu,
na ɔmaa no kaa ne dodom a,
afei deɛ n’aduane asakyera ne nsono mu,
nhuritia borɔ wɔ ne yam.
Wamene adedodoɔ, na ɔbɛfe bio,
Onyankopɔn bɛtu afiri ne yam.
Ɔbɛfefe ahuritia borɔ,
na ɔprammire tɛkyerɛma bɛku no.
N’ani rennye nsuwansuwa ho,
ɛwoɔ ne nufosuo ani sradeɛ asuasu nsubɔntene ho.
Ɔbɛdane deɛ wabrɛ ho ama,
na ɔremmene,
n’adeɛ a wanya no, ɔrenni ho ahurisie,
sɛdeɛ ne dodoɔ teɛ no.
Ɛfiri sɛ wapɛkyɛ mmɔborɔfoɔ apo wɔn,
na wafa efie a ɛnyɛ ɔno na ɔsiiɛ.

Ɛnam sɛ ne yafunu ammee da nti,
ɔrenkora deɛ n’ani gye ho no biara.
Wannidi annya bi da,
enti n’ahonyadeɛ rentena hɔ.
N’adedodoɔ mayɛ mu ne ho bɛhiahia no,
amanehunufoɔ nyinaa nsa bɛba ne so.
Ɔbɛma n’abufuhyeɛ aba ne so
ama no de ahyɛ n’afuru ma,
na ɔbɛma no atɔ agu ne so de ayɛ n’aduane.
Ɔdwane firi dadeɛ akodeɛ ano a,
kɔbere mfrafraeɛ agyan bɛwɔ no ahwire ne mu;
ɔtu firi ne honam mu
na agyan no firi ne bɔnwoma mu a,
ewuo ho hu bɛto ne so.
Wɔde sum nyinaa asie n’akoradeɛ,
ogya a obi mfite mu bɛhye no,
ɛbɛhye deɛ aka ne ntomadan mu.
Ɔsoro bɛyi n’amumuyɛ adi,
na asase bɛsɔre atia no.
Wɔbɛsoa ne fie ahonyadeɛ akɔ,
wɔbɛtwe akɔ, n’abufuo da no.
Yei ne onipa ɔbɔnefoɔ kyɛfa a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn,
ne n’agyapadeɛ a Onyankopɔn ahyɛ ama no no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
